title: Blueberry Overnight Oats
excerpt: Prepare a practical, creamy, flavor-packed breakfast with these overnight oats. The perfect touch comes from our fresh high-mountain blueberries.
imageAlt: A glass jar of creamy overnight oats topped with plenty of fresh Fresh Pick blueberries and a pinch of cinnamon.
steps: In a glass jar or medium bowl, mix the rolled oats, the chia seeds and the pinch of ground cinnamon.
Add the milk, Greek yogurt, honey and vanilla extract. Stir very well with a spoon until all the ingredients are fully combined.
Gently fold in half of the Fresh Pick blueberries, taking care not to break them so their beautiful natural bloom stays intact.
Seal the jar tightly and refrigerate it overnight (or at least 8 hours) so the oats hydrate and take on their characteristic creamy texture.
The next day, take it out of the fridge and stir gently. If the oats seem too thick, add a splash of cold milk to taste.
Top with the other half of the fresh Fresh Pick blueberries, lovingly grown in the high mountains of Guasca, and enjoy a fresh, delicious breakfast.
tips: To enjoy the crunch and the natural sweetness of 13° to 15° Brix of our blueberries to the fullest, add them fresh right before eating the oats.
You can prepare up to three jars on Sunday and keep them in the fridge; they stay in perfect condition for up to 4 days to solve your weekday mornings.
